headline: Argentina Country Risk Exceeds 700 Points as Official Dollar Hits Record
summary: Argentina's country risk index climbed back above 700 points as the official dollar exchange rate hit a record high, weighing on foreign holdings of Argentine bonds and shares.
why: Country risk indicators and currency devaluation metrics gauge sovereign default probabilities and foreign investor confidence in emerging market economies.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Record exchange rates and elevated country risk scores increase borrowing costs and depress asset valuations.

why_moved: A weakening currency and rising sovereign risk spreads diminished investor demand for local debt and equity instruments.
